items.title: August Lanoix Interview, 1961-04-19
items.q: Because at that time I think Walter Pichon was playing up there.

ctx.x: You'll get your whole life down sometimes, do you? You got time, do you? You got time? Yeah. Do you remember any other jobs that you had much? You mentioned Pelican and all those... Did you stay there quite a while? Did you play there every week? No, no, only spots. Just spot jobs.

Only spots nights, you know. When the other bands wouldn't be there that they had. Because at that time I think Walter Pichon was playing up there. And sometimes we played with other bands. Two bands. Yeah. Contests.
And this band then came before the other T-Boy Ramey.
